_doc: Canonical research buckets — seeded by consolidating BLACKBOX5 (19 tier-weighted categories) + repo-catalog/categories.json (5 harvest) + agency-specific areas. Seeded once via seed.py. After this, agents add-or-create via topics.py. keywords route artifacts; gh_topics feed the harvest runner.

buckets.title: Memory & Context
buckets.desc: How agents store, recall, prune, and carry context across turns and sessions.

buckets.title: Reasoning & Planning
buckets.desc: Decomposition, multi-step planning, deliberation, and reasoning strategies.

buckets.title: Skills & Capabilities
buckets.desc: Tool/skill systems, capability discovery, MCP, function calling.

buckets.title: Execution & Safety
buckets.desc: Safe execution, sandboxing, permissioning, approval gates, guardrails.

buckets.title: AI Coding Agents
buckets.desc: Autonomous/assisted coding agents and harnesses (the harvest 'ai-coding-agents' category).

buckets.title: Agent Orchestration
buckets.desc: Coordinating many agents: swarms, crews, subagents, handoffs, orchestration frameworks.

buckets.title: Learning & Adaptation
buckets.desc: Self-improvement, feedback loops, adaptation, lessons, online learning.

buckets.title: Data Architecture
buckets.desc: How data/knowledge is modeled, stored, and moved through the system.

buckets.title: Performance & Optimization
buckets.desc: Latency, cost, token economy, caching, throughput tuning.

buckets.title: Prompt Engineering
buckets.desc: Prompt libraries, system prompts, optimization, eval-driven prompting (harvest 'prompt-engineering').

buckets.title: RAG & Research Retrieval
buckets.desc: Retrieval, RAG, deep-research harnesses, scraping, knowledge graphs (harvest 'research-packets').

buckets.title: Security & Governance
buckets.desc: Security posture, governance, audit, compliance, secrets, privacy.

buckets.title: Orchestration Frameworks
buckets.desc: The named frameworks/SDKs for building agent systems.

buckets.title: Observability & Monitoring
buckets.desc: Tracing, metrics, logging, dashboards, telemetry for agent systems.

buckets.title: Communication & Collaboration
buckets.desc: Agent-to-agent comms, protocols, collaboration patterns.

buckets.title: Integrations & Providers
buckets.desc: Provider adapters, third-party integrations, connectors.

buckets.title: Agency Staff Automation
buckets.desc: Automating agency operations: client onboarding, outreach, proposals, reporting (harvest 'agency-staff-automation').

buckets.title: Reusable Agency Code & UI
buckets.desc: Reusable frontends, dashboards, SaaS boilerplate, components (harvest 'reusable-agency-code').

buckets.title: User Experience & Interface
buckets.desc: How humans interact with agents: voice, TUI, panels, design systems.

buckets.title: Evals & Benchmarks
buckets.desc: Evaluating agents: benchmarks, eval harnesses, scoring.

buckets.title: Testing & Validation
buckets.desc: Test strategies, validation, TDD, CI for agent code.

buckets.title: State Management
buckets.desc: Session/agent state, checkpointing, resume, leases.

buckets.title: Deployment & DevOps
buckets.desc: Deploying and serving agents/models; infra and ops.

buckets.title: Documentation & Knowledge
buckets.desc: Docs, wikis, codebase maps, knowledge bases for agents and humans.
